title: Technical summary
text: Detail-driven technical troubleshooter with 10+ years diagnosing and repairing complex industrial, automotive, security, and broadband systems. I specialize in turning unclear problems into clear, step-by-step solutions and documenting fixes so others can repeat them.

title: Email triage project blurb
text: Built a Python-based email triage tool that reads plain-text items, classifies them into categories such as URGENT, MONEY, JOB_LEAD, and PERSONAL, and outputs both a JSON report and a human-readable summary to speed up support workflows.
